newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Parker Hannifin started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Parker Hannifin started.

text.p: PaineWebber said on Tuesday analyst David Bleustein started coverage of Parker Hannifin Corp with an attractive rating.
-- Bleustein said his 12-month target was $73 to $75 per share, his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate was $4.30 per share and his fiscal 1999 estimate was $4.90 per share.
-- "This is a truly diversified industrial company and each of its eight operating divisions has an attractive growth story," he said.
-- The company benefits from factory automation, awareness of electromagnetic interference, a muted business cycle and a trend to vendor consolidation, he said.
